# Group / Guild Calendar for Classic TBC

Version: v3.0.1-alpha

by: [**inphix**](https://www.wowinterface.com/forums/member.php?s=72d16e387b2e734b268fb2e46c6fef83&action=getinfo&userid=351581) [ [More](https://www.wowinterface.com/downloads/author-351581.html) ]

About Group / Guild Calendar for Classic TBC  
This project is a ported version of the Group Calendar addon from Classic (1.37.7).  
  
Note: Due to changes made by Blizzard, the addon only works within a single guild.  
  
Key Features:  
  
Schedule events/dungeons/raids using a calendar display  
View attendance by category  
Tools to help you invite members to a group/raid  
Trust settings restrict who can create events  
View dates/times in local or server time  
View schedule from an alt  
You can display the calendar in 3 ways:  
  
Type /calendar in the chat window  
Click on the sun/moon image near the minimap  
Click the minimap icon  
  
  
If you would like to support development, you can donate here. (original author, not me)  
  
Localisations other than english have not been updated if anyone else wants to do this, feel free.  
  
This port is untested for the most part, but everything appears to be visually working.  
  
  
  
Please report any bugs using the issues tracker.
